Name: Six Corners Farm
Author: DeLiXxN
Description:
Did you ever feel the Four Corners map is too small?
Fear no more for "Six Corners Farm" will give each player an additional, unlockable area!
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/15132/15132-1709348543-427038095.png[/img]

[b]New features include:[/b]
- Forage spawning in the backyard
- Snails visiting the pasture
- Fishing is actually viable now (in the small pond at the bottom left only though)
- Weeds regrowth area
- Secret pathways
- Tons of unlockable Farming space
- Chance for an additional Large stump to spawn
- Designated forestry areas, keep your backwoods clean!
- Some snacks to start off with. No more fighting for foraging for extra energy early on

This map is an edit of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8894]KFThomas' 8 Corners Farm[/url], which in turn is an edit of the vanilla Four Corners Farm.
